posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong just became the 7th player in MLB history with a 40-homer, 40-steal season. He walked in first PA & immediately stole 2B. He joins Shohei Ohtani (2024), Ronald Acuña Jr (2023), Alfonso Soriano (2006), Alex Rodriguez (1998), Barry Bonds (1996) & José Canseco (1988) in 40-40 club
posts.jp: ピート・クロウ-アームストロングがMLB史上7人目の40本塁打40盗塁シーズンを達成。大谷翔平(2024)、ロナルド・アクーニャJr(2023)など40-40クラブの仲間入り🎉

posts.text: The Cubs are going to the postseason for a 2nd consecutive year. They beat the Marlins, 2-1, to clinch their playoff spot.

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: The Phillies, who are making it much harder on themselves, have lost again. They might have lost Luis Arraez too. Those who stayed until the end are booing. The vibes are not great.
posts.jp: 自分たちで難しくしているフィリーズが再び敗北。ルイス・アライェスも失った可能性。スタジアムはブーイング。雰囲気は最悪だ😞

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: For the third consecutive season and the 19th time in franchise history, the Guardians are headed to the postseason. Cleveland's magic number to win its third straight AL Central title is three.
posts.jp: ガーディアンスが3年連続でポストシーズン進出決定。3年連続AL中地区優勝までのマジックナンバーは3

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: John Schneider said that Vladdy's comments had "unfortunate timing", but they will help him dealing with "feeling the weight of being the guy every single day." "The player, the person I know in Vlad, he is by no means saying, 'OK, I got paid and I'm good with that.'" #BlueJays

reply_texts.text:
Anyone who thinks that Vladdy wasn't the person who was the most upset with how Vladdy was playing this season wasn't actually watching the games.

He wants to be The Man. He never stopped trying this season. Should he have taken more time off for injuries? Maybe. But don't question if he cares.
reply_texts.author: davethecamel.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Of course not. Anyone yapping that translation is click baiting and doesn't know Vladdy
reply_texts.author: arewethereyet.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: i have never seen anyone put their whole ass into something as much as i've seen that man put his whole ass into it. like for a long time the prevailing narrative was just that he was trying too hard, and now the same sorts are pushing that he doesn't give a shit?
reply_texts.author: neongrey.bsky.social

reply_texts.text:
I had no problem with what Vladdy said. After enough time in my career, every time I was offered a new job, my salary contract was based on my experience to date.
If he didn't care, he wouldn't have played 1st base as well as he did.
reply_texts.author: lspv.bsky.social

posts.jp: シュナイダー監督：ブラディミール・ゲレーロJrの発言は「タイミングが悪かった」が、彼が「毎日"その人"であることの重圧」を処理するのに役立つと語った。#BlueJays

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Go to bed. The Phillies will not clinch tonight. They went 0-for-12 with runners in scoring position.
posts.jp: 寝ろ。フィリーズは今夜優勝しない。走者がいる場面で12打数0安打だ😴
